title: Fleet of Quotes
description: A dispatcher is comparing shipping costs across five different hub-to-hub routes before choosing which lane to book. Confirm the pricing engine produces internally consistent, monotonically sensible results across a spread of distances and package sizes.
successCondition: Using at least 3 real hub pairs from GET /api/booking/geocode at increasing distances apart, and an identical package for all three, call POST /api/booking/quote for each. The three priceCents values strictly increase as distanceKm increases (holding the package constant), and for every one of the three responses, priceCents exactly equals baseFeeCents + weightFeeCents + distanceFeeCents.
hints: Pick hub pairs with a clearly increasing distance spread (e.g. two hubs on the same coast, then one across an ocean) so the monotonic relationship isn't muddied by near-identical distances.
weightFeeCents should be identical across all three calls since the package doesn't change — only distanceFeeCents (and therefore priceCents) should move.
